mobilebase.creative_only: Assembly and disassembly are available in Creative mode.
mobilebase.launch_hint: Right-click the core with an empty hand to preview assembly. Right-click again within 10 seconds to confirm.
mobilebase.launch_preview: %s hull blocks in cyan, %s parts in gold, about %s kg. Right-click again within 10 seconds to assemble.
mobilebase.launched: Assembly complete. Fuel the engine and use the helm. Sneak and right-click the core to drop anchor.
mobilebase.use_core: Use the core to preview and confirm safe disassembly.
mobilebase.park: Anchor requested. Once the vehicle has stopped and everyone is off, right-click the core to preview disassembly.
mobilebase.dock_preview: %s landing positions in cyan. Right-click again within 10 seconds to disassemble.
mobilebase.docked: Disassembled. Edit the structure and preview assembly again.
mobilebase.error.boundary: The connected structure is too large or attached to the shore or a support. Separate it first.
mobilebase.error.unloaded: The scan reaches an unloaded chunk or exceeds the build height.
mobilebase.error.unsupported: This block cannot be moved safely at %s.
mobilebase.error.multiple_helms: Each vehicle can have only one helm.
mobilebase.error.helm_space: Leave two floor blocks behind the helm and two blocks of headroom.
mobilebase.error.deck_space: No free component position was found.
mobilebase.error.anchor: Leave a floor block and an unpowered anchor position to the right of the core. Use only one anchor.
mobilebase.error.water: At least one column under the hull needs sufficiently deep water.
mobilebase.error.floater_space: Not enough free space for floaters at the waterline.
mobilebase.error.mass: The structure's mass could not be calculated.
mobilebase.error.entity: An entity occupies a planned component position. Clear it and try again.
mobilebase.error.foreign_ship: This structure was assembled by a different system.
mobilebase.error.not_stopped: Sneak and right-click the core to drop anchor. Wait for cruise control to disengage and the vehicle to stop.
mobilebase.error.alignment: The vehicle is not aligned to the block grid. Release the anchor and use the Eureka helm to align it.
mobilebase.error.aboard: Move passengers, dropped items, and animals clear before disassembly.
mobilebase.error.occupied: The destination is outside the boundary, unloaded, or occupied by another vehicle.
mobilebase.error.occupied_at: The destination at %s is occupied or cannot be replaced safely.
mobilebase.error.dock_size: The structure has unloaded chunks, an invalid number of cores, or too many blocks.
mobilebase.error.rolled_back: Verification failed. Blocks and data were restored. See the server log.
mobilebase.marker.heading: Vehicle heading
mobilebase.marker.surface: Aim at a face of a block in the structure.
mobilebase.adapted_preview: %s hull blocks and %s parts (about %s kg). Buoyancy and power will be adjusted. Right-click again to confirm.
mobilebase.adapted_launched: Boat assembled with adjusted settings. Add coal to the engine before driving.
mobilebase.error.marked_helm: The marked driver's position needs connected floor blocks and room to drive and get off.
mobilebase.error.marked_engine: The marked engine would obstruct the structure or driver's space.
mobilebase.error.marked_floater: Mark a floater on the underside of the hull facing the water. The target position must be free.
mobilebase.error.marked_installed: A component is already installed. Clear its mark or move the existing part first.
mobilebase.error.marker_in_world: Assembly marks can only be applied to a core that has not been assembled.
mobilebase.marker.help: Choose a part, aim at a face, then right-click.
mobilebase.land_preview: The land assembly will add %s parts. Right-click again to confirm.
mobilebase.land_launched: Assembled. W/S drive, A/D steer, C cruise.
mobilebase.error.land_deps: Land vehicles require Create Fabric and Trackwork Refabricated.
mobilebase.error.land_wheels: Leave two clear axles at least three blocks apart.
mobilebase.error.land_extra: A wheel or motor at %s is outside the planned layout.
mobilebase.error.land_marks: Remove engine, floater, or balloon marks.
mobilebase.error.boat_wheel_marks: The boat core does not use wheel marks. Clear them or use a land core.
mobilebase.air_preview: %s aircraft blocks, %s parts to add, about %s kg. Right-click again to confirm.
mobilebase.air_launched: Aircraft assembled. Fuel the engine. Space ascends and V descends.
mobilebase.error.balloon_space: No suitable balloon support was found. Leave free space outside the driver's area.
mobilebase.error.marked_balloon: Mark a balloon on a clear roof surface away from the driver's position.
mobilebase.error.vehicle_marks: Use marks that match the vehicle type.
mobilebase.sub_preview: %s submarine blocks, %s parts to add, about %s kg. Right-click again to confirm.
mobilebase.sub_launched: Submarine assembled. Fuel the engine. V dives and Space surfaces.
mobilebase.create_select: Right-click an assembly station or hanging carriage.
mobilebase.create_preview: %s vehicle blocks and %s parts to add. Right-click again to confirm gluing.
mobilebase.create_train_ready: Carriage ready. Assemble it at the Create station.
mobilebase.create_cabin_ready: Cabin glued. Power the gantry shaft to move it.
mobilebase.error.create_missing: Install the compatible version of Create Fabric first.
mobilebase.error.create_target: Select an assembly station or hanging carriage.
mobilebase.error.create_bogey: Place a bogey on the first blue position at the station.
mobilebase.error.create_body: Connect the cabin to the bogey or gantry carriage.
mobilebase.error.create_controls: No free position for the controls. Leave a clear block above the cabin floor.
mobilebase.error.create_overlap: An extra block at %s is inside the cabin footprint. Separate the platform from the cabin.
mobilebase.error.create_glue_boundary: Existing glue extends outside the cabin. Remove it with the Super Glue tool before continuing.
mobilebase.error.create_glue: Could not place Create Super Glue.
mobilebase.error.create_capture: The blocks captured by Create did not match the preview. Check gaps and attached blocks.
